name: KNIT 360 Debit Note
description: FR-PROC-006 / FR-FIN-002 - Returns. A purchase reduced or sent back. Posts, so it submits.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The company issuing the debit note.

fields.label: Against Supplier Invoice
fields.description: The bill this debits. Named, the debit reduces what that bill still owes; left blank, it sits as a balance in our favour against a later bill.

fields.label: Posting Date
fields.description: The date this lands in the books.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why the supplier owes it back. Required: a debit note with no reason is one the supplier will dispute.

fields.label: Debit To
fields.description: The payable account this debits, taken from the bill it adjusts so the debit lands where the debt was put.

fields.label: Business Status
fields.description: Where this document has got to. Moved with the buttons at the top of this form, never typed.

fields.label: Items
fields.description: What is being returned or disputed.

fields.label: Net Total
fields.description: Sum of the line amounts, before tax.

fields.label: Statutory Tax Amount
fields.description: Tax being reversed, as the supplier's own credit note states it. Entered, not computed, for the same reason the bill's tax is.

fields.label: Grand Total
fields.description: The whole amount the supplier owes back.
